title: Koh Samui vs Koh Phangan: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Koh Samui for families, couples, and first-timers. Koh Phangan for the Full Moon Party, yoga retreats, and digital nomads. Only 40 min apart by ferry — do both if you have 7+ days.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Samui has more variety; Phangan has stunning hidden beaches in the north but party beaches in the south.

categories.name: Party & Nightlife
categories.summary: Phangan has the Full Moon Party. Samui has solid resort nightlife.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Phangan is 20-30% cheaper day-to-day. Samui has the airport premium.

categories.name: Families & Couples
categories.summary: Samui has calm north beaches, better hospitals, and less party intrusion.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Samui has a direct airport. Phangan is ferry-only.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Samui has far more restaurant variety across all price points.

categories.name: Wellness & Yoga
categories.summary: Phangan is one of Asia top wellness destinations with world-class yoga schools.

categories.name: Digital Nomads
categories.summary: Phangan has dedicated coworking spaces and a larger remote worker community.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.summary: Samui has better roads, hospitals, and services.

categories.name: Best Time
categories.summary: Both peak Dec-Apr. Samui is worst in November (monsoon). FMP is year-round on Phangan.

categories.name: Budget Accommodation
categories.summary: Budget guesthouses on Phangan run ฿400-800 vs ฿600-1,200 on Samui.

faq.question: Is Koh Samui or Koh Phangan better for families?
faq.answer: Koh Samui is clearly better for families — proper airport, better hospitals, calm beaches away from party zones.

faq.question: How do you get from Koh Samui to Koh Phangan?
faq.answer: 40-minute ferry from Na Thon or Big Buddha pier to Thong Sala. Costs ฿350-500 (-14). Multiple daily crossings.

faq.question: Is the Full Moon Party worth it?
faq.answer: Once is memorable. Stay in the north, take a tuk-tuk to Haad Rin, leave by 2am, dont bring valuables.
